title: When a phone does not arrive
breadcrumb: When a phone does not arrive

slides.title: See what happened
slides.html: odmdm-fleet phones says where each phone is, and why one was refused.

slides.title: Fix the cause
slides.html: The name is taken or not allowed, enrolment is closed, or Fleet has an old challenge.

slides.title: Ask again
slides.html: odmdm-fleet resend asks again for every refused phone. A phone you rename asks by itself.

slides.title: Never swap the certificate
slides.html: Do not replace the team's certificate in Fleet to retry. Every phone in the team would lose its own.

slides.title: A phone comes back
slides.html: A wiped phone keeps its old name, and Deploy App gives no name twice. Give the phone a new one.

slides.title: Retire the old callsign
slides.html: Renaming leaves the old callsign behind. Remove it in User Management.

slides.title: Certificate Authentication Failed
slides.html: The phone has its certificate but lost the rule that lets Chrome use it. Run odmdm-fleet apply --force-policy, then restart the phone.
